capabilities: Pull ACTRA daily logs, notes and recording summaries into the vault as Markdown
Upload Markdown from individually authorized folders to ACTRA
Connect an ACTRA account via OAuth and store tokens in Obsidian SecretStorage
Run automatic pull and upload cycles roughly every 24 hours with manual triggers
Protect user edits with conflict copies and actra-synced tagging to prevent data loops
extras: README is mostly in Chinese with an English section; the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; audio attachment download and task status write-back are planned for later phases; the ACTRA API currently has no remote deletion, so uploaded copies cannot be removed from the plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull ACTRA activity data into a vault or push selected local Markdown to an ACTRA service.

relations.evidence: Actra connects an ACTRA account to a local vault.

summary: Syncs an ACTRA account's daily logs, notes and recording summaries into a vault as Markdown and uploads explicitly authorized local Markdown folders back.
